title: AAVE-Snap
tagline: The metamask snap notifies the user of all information related to AAVE (APY, Supply change,...)
description: It is essential for investors to provide information about the APY or AAVE pool fluctuations to help them make the right decisions about their investments. So I wrote a Metamask Snap to notify users about fluctuations in the total supply of the pools as well as view their information.
how_its_made: I built the frontend using next and snap from the metamask snap template. Then I wrote an API to get pool information using @aave/contract-helpers. To deploy the notification I use metamask snap's cron feature to call my api every minute. I would also like to add a general notice about pools. It will be very useful when applications can integrate and users can view information easily
